attributes.title: DDW 2027
attributes.organizer: Digestive Disease Week (AASLD, AGA, ASGE, SSAT)
attributes.summary:
DDW 2027 takes place May 15 to 18, 2027, in Washington, D.C., with an online option. In person, attendees can access around 400 original sessions; the online program streams 64 key sessions on four channels, and in-person sessions are later available on demand. The exhibit hall is open May 16 to 18.

Abstracts are accepted until December 2, 2026. Registration opens January 20, 2027, for members of the four sponsoring societies and January 27 for everyone else. Early-bird pricing ends March 10, 2027: $252 for members and $693 for nonmembers, the same in person and online; rates rise on March 11 and again on May 14. CME and MOC can be claimed after the meeting; credit totals were not shown on the pages we checked.
